title: Minimum Operations to Halve Array Sum
goal: Halve the total array sum using the fewest individual halving operations.
strategy: Halving the current largest value gives the largest immediate reduction. Keep a max-heap, repeatedly halve its maximum, and stop when accumulated reduction reaches half the original sum.
